posts.title: 5 Late Signs Your Startup Is Failing (and Which Are Fixable)
posts.description: The late signs a startup is failing: roadmaps that only slide right, headcount outrunning revenue, founders lost in the narrative, and your best people leaving.

posts.title: Python Logging Done Right
posts.description: Set up Python logging once so it works in every module: loggers, handlers and formatters, dictConfig, log levels, JSON logs, and where print() falls short.

posts.title: How to be a Good Farrier: What the Car Teaches Us About AI and Your Job
posts.description: The fight over AI at work is a rerun of the fight over the automobile. Newspaper quotes from 1899 to 1913, Census occupation counts for blacksmiths and teamsters, Model T prices, and current AI adoption data, plus what to do if you're worried about your job.
